example: The shop sells various kinds of tea.
rrgm_bridge: Various gathers many different things under one word without listing them.
invariant_mi: Of several different kinds or instances.

domain_entries.LIN: Quantifier implying variety as well as number.

count_condition: Several items differing from one another.
transfer_boundary: "Various sources say" leaves the sources unchecked; name them where it matters.

common_meaning: Travelling through a place on the way to another; also by means of.
example: We flew to Rome via Paris; send it via email.
rrgm_bridge: Via names the route or channel something passes through.
invariant_mi: By way of, or by means of.
count_condition: A route or medium through which something passes.
transfer_boundary: The route is not the destination; a message sent via a channel can be read or changed there.
